requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several issues with incorrect handling of various data types and modes, particularly in string and list encoding. The implementation falls back to returning '0x00' for many cases instead of proper RLP encoding.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode function to correctly implement the RLP (Recursive Length Prefix) encoding algorithm for all supported data types (integers, strings, lists) and str_modes ('text', 'hex', 'default'). The function should properly handle edge cases like empty strings, single-byte strings, and large data that requires extended length prefixes.

requirement.description: The cryptographic functions (private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, get_signer_public_key) are missing proper error handling and are importing dependencies without checking if they are available. This leads to ImportError exceptions when required packages are not installed.
requirement.contract: Update the cryptographic functions to properly check for required dependencies (ecdsa, hashlib) and provide clear error messages when they are missing. Ensure that all functions properly handle inputs and provide consistent return types.

requirement.description: The get_created_address function has issues with the RLP encoding for CREATE2 addresses. The implementation incorrectly handles the data concatenation for CREATE2 addresses and doesn't properly handle the keccak256 hashing.
requirement.contract: Fix the get_created_address function to properly implement CREATE2 address derivation according to EIP-1014. The function should correctly RLP encode the data [0xff, sender, salt, keccak256(init_code)] and then take the keccak256 hash of this data, extracting the last 20 bytes for the address.

requirement.description: The rlp_decode function has incomplete implementation for different types of decoding (ascii, raw_hex, prefix_hex) and doesn't properly handle the fallback when rlp package is not available.
requirement.contract: Complete the rlp_decode function implementation to properly handle different decoding types and ensure robust fallback behavior when the rlp package is not available.

requirement.description: Some files in the codebase are missing the __future__ import annotations which is required for proper type hinting and compatibility.
requirement.contract: Add the missing from __future__ import annotations to all Python files that are missing this import to ensure consistent type hinting behavior across the codebase.
